messages:
maria: Heads up — CI/grafana reporting pipeline started failing for eval-runner jobs right after the canary deploy. Ingestion is rejecting metrics: 'eval.metric/quality' not found in upstream. Logs attached.
kevin: I see the alert. Dashboards show zeros for rouge/bleu/accuracy across the last 3 runs. Looks like metric names disappeared rather than values dropping.
junaid: That matches my change in PR #842 — I normalized metric names to dot-separated 'eval.metrics.quality' to match the new telemetry agent. I thought ingestion would be updated too, but apparently the ingest path still expects slash-separated names.
harper: Can reproduce locally by piping runner stdout to jq. Minimal repro:
```
eval-runner --job=mini | jq '.metrics[] | select(.name | test("quality"))'
```
returns nothing for recent builds.
devon: Is this only canary or also staging? Which release contained #842?
maria: rc-2026-03-19 included #842 and was rolled to canary at 09:12 PT. Canary is ~30% traffic.
ci-bot: build rc-20260319 deployed to canary. eval-reporting job: 12 failed / 15 total. Ingestion errors: 502 from metric-collector.
kevin: Quick triage plan: (1) bisect whether the rename is root cause; (2) if so, either rollback the canary or emit both metric names as a compatibility shim; (3) update dashboards to accept both names.
junaid: I can push a shim to telemetry emitter that emits both 'eval.metric/quality' and 'eval.metrics.quality'. Will open a PR now and run a quick canary test.
harper: Also need to update PromQLs on dashboards to be resilient: use regex or OR between names. I'll prepare the dashboard patch.
devon: Decision needed: hold rollout. Rollback only if shim can't be ready in 1 hour. Who will perform rollback if needed?
maria: I'll be on-call for rollout decisions. If shim missing by 13:30 PT I'll patch canary to previous rc. I'll open an incident page.
eva: Adding a permanent note to the eval-harness runbook: "metric name contract between runner and ingest must be preserved or shims provided".
kevin: QA checklist once shim lands: 1) run full quant/llama eval on canary; 2) confirm metrics appear in S3/reporting; 3) confirm dashboard graphs show non-zero and time-aligned values.
junaid: PR #895 opened: telemetry shim emits both names, toggled behind feature-flag 'emit_legacy_metrics'. Running unit + integration tests now.
maria: OK. keep infra and dashboards in the loop. If tests pass, we'll merge and monitor canary for 3 runs before proceeding. :thumbsup:
harper: Pushed dashboard patch draft and linked it to the PR. Using a PromQL OR to cover both names temporarily.
ci-bot: PR #895 CI: unit tests passed, integration tests queued.
maria: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the source of truth for the incident. We'll annotate rollback decision in the incident doc if applied.
